meta.name: Localcraft
meta.description: Home-services site: services with clear scope, service areas, work gallery, team and quote or callback inquiries
meta.author: ZeroHostCMS community

children.text: Localcraft is a small team of home-repair tradespeople working out of a workshop in Millbrook. We started with weekend repairs for neighbours and grew into a team that covers repairs, plumbing fixes, painting, carpentry, tiling and assembly.

We keep things straightforward: tell us what needs doing, we read every request, and we call or email back to talk through the job. We would rather explain what we do not take on than promise something we cannot deliver.

Send a quote or callback request with a short description and, if you can, a photo. We reply to talk through scope and timing. A request is the start of a conversation; it is not a booking, and nothing is scheduled until we have agreed it with you.
Call us during office hours, email, or send the form below. Tell us what needs doing, roughly where you are, and whether you would like a quote or simply a call back.

data.title: Localcraft business details
data.response_note: We aim to reply to enquiries within one working day. A request is not a booked appointment; we will call or email to talk it through.
data.hero_text: Reliable home repair services to keep your home comfortable, functional and looking its best.

hero_image.alt: A craftsman in a canvas apron planing timber in a bright workshop

data.footer_left: A more comfortable home is a brighter tomorrow.

data.title: Repairs
data.summary: Fix what matters. From door handles to drywall, we take care of the details.

featured_image.alt: Hands guiding a hand plane along a timber board in the workshop

children.text: Small household repairs are the bulk of our work: the sticking door, the loose shelf, the dent in the hallway wall. We look at the job, explain what we think it needs, and agree the scope with you before starting.
If something turns out to be bigger than a repair, we will say so and suggest who to talk to.

data.included:
Doors, hinges, handles and locks that stick or rattle
Patching and sanding small holes and dents in plasterboard
Re-fixing loose shelves, rails and curtain tracks
Sealant and caulking around baths, sinks and windows
Minor fence and gate adjustments
data.not_included:
Structural work or load-bearing walls
Roofing and work at height above a single storey
Gas, mains electrical or anything requiring a licensed trade
Emergency call-outs
data.typical_job: Most repair visits are a few hours; we confirm scope after reviewing your request.

data.title: Plumbing
data.summary: Leaky taps, running toilets and more. Fast, dependable plumbing solutions.

featured_image.alt: Pegboard wall of hand tools above a workbench

children.text: We handle everyday plumbing fixes inside the home: dripping taps, running cisterns, slow drains and replacing like-for-like fittings.
Tell us what you are seeing and, if you can, send a photo of the fitting. It helps us bring the right parts.

data.included:
Dripping and stiff taps (washers, cartridges, aerators)
Running or slow-filling toilet cisterns
Clearing slow sink and basin drains
Replacing like-for-like taps, shower heads and toilet seats
Fitting washing-machine and dishwasher connections
data.not_included:
Gas appliances, boilers and hot-water cylinders
New pipe runs, bathroom refits or moving fixtures
Blocked sewer lines and excavation
Emergency call-outs
data.typical_job: Simple fixes are often done in one visit; parts may need a second visit.

data.title: Painting
data.summary: Freshen up your space inside or out. Clean results and careful craftsmanship.

featured_image.alt: Dark workshop sign reading Better homes, brighter days with a yellow house logo

children.text: We paint single rooms, hallways, doors, trims and small exterior areas. Preparation is most of the job: filling, sanding and protecting floors and furniture before any paint goes on.
You choose the colours; we can suggest finishes that suit the room and how it is used.

data.included:
Walls, ceilings and trims for single rooms and hallways
Interior doors and skirting boards
Filling, sanding and priming before painting
Dust sheets and masking of floors and fittings
Fences, gates and small exterior timber areas
data.not_included:
Whole-house exteriors and multi-storey scaffolding
Wallpaper hanging or removal
Lead paint removal
Supplying colour-matched specialist coatings
data.typical_job: A typical room takes one to three days including preparation and drying time.

data.title: Carpentry
data.summary: Shelving, trims and small builds made to fit your home.

featured_image.alt: Pale timber board on a workbench covered in fresh wood shavings

children.text: From a run of alcove shelves to replacing a damaged skirting board, we measure on site and cut to fit. Most pieces are built in our Millbrook workshop and fitted in one visit.
We are happy to work with timber you have already chosen or recommend something suitable.

data.included:
Alcove and wall-mounted shelving
Replacing skirting boards, architraves and trims
Easing and re-hanging internal doors
Simple garden planters and bench seats
Repairs to decking boards and steps
data.not_included:
Staircases and structural framing
Fitted kitchens and wardrobes
Decks and pergolas needing permits
Bespoke furniture commissions
data.typical_job: Measuring visit first, then fitting once the pieces are ready.

data.title: Tiling & grout
data.summary: Re-grouting, re-sealing and small tiling repairs for kitchens and bathrooms.

featured_image.alt: Wooden crate stencilled with Good work builds happier homes

children.text: Tired grout and cracked tiles make a room look older than it is. We regrout, replace individual tiles where matching tiles are available, and reseal edges so water stays where it should.
Splashbacks and small areas are fine; full bathroom tiling is outside what we offer.

data.included:
Raking out and regrouting wall and floor tiles
Replacing individual cracked tiles (when matches are available)
Resealing showers, baths and worktops
Small kitchen splashbacks
data.not_included:
Full bathroom or wet-room installations
Underfloor heating
Waterproofing membranes and tanking
Natural stone restoration
data.typical_job: Regrouting a shower usually takes a day, plus curing time before use.

data.title: Assembly & fixtures
data.summary: Flat-pack, wall mounting and fixtures put together properly.

featured_image.alt: Bright workshop with a pendant lamp, timber shelves and a yellow house sign

children.text: Flat-pack furniture, wall-mounted TVs, mirrors, blinds and curtain poles: the jobs that take an afternoon and the right fixings. We check the wall type before drilling and use fixings rated for the load.
Please have items delivered and unpacked in the right room before the visit if you can.

data.included:
Flat-pack furniture assembly
Mounting TVs, mirrors, pictures and shelves
Fitting blinds, curtain poles and tracks
Anchoring tall furniture to walls for safety
data.not_included:
Wiring, sockets or hard-wired light fittings
Moving heavy furniture between floors
Disposal of packaging in bulk
Appliance installation needing a licensed trade
data.typical_job: Most assembly jobs are completed in a single visit.

data.title: Harbourside
data.summary: Terraced houses and apartments around the old harbour wall.
data.notes: Street parking is limited; let us know if there is a loading bay or driveway we can use.

data.title: Millbrook
data.summary: Family homes along the brook and the newer streets east of the school.
data.notes: Our workshop is in Millbrook, so this is usually the easiest area for short visits.

data.title: Eastvale
data.summary: Post-war bungalows and semi-detached homes on the eastern ridge.
data.notes: Many Eastvale homes have older fittings; we will mention it if a part needs to be sourced first.

data.title: Cedar Heights
data.summary: Hillside homes with decks, fences and plenty of exterior paintwork.
data.notes: Exterior work here depends on the weather; we will talk through timing when we reply.

data.title: Old Quarry
data.summary: Converted cottages and small workshops on the edge of town.
data.notes: Some lanes are narrow; tell us about access when you send your request.
